items.title: Contract rent is unknown and blank

items.detail: Only a 2030-2035 window was provided by the owner. Expiry-year rows in the model are a grid over that window, not a fact (M65).

items.title: City vs County location unresolved (Measure ULA applicability)
items.detail: 'Central Los Angeles' can mean the City of Los Angeles (ULA applies: 4.45% all-in tier 1) or unincorporated county (no ULA, county documentary transfer tax only). The owner's phrase does not resolve it, and the exact address is withheld for privacy (M85). The model therefore publishes both a with-ULA and a without-ULA case.
items.owner_action: Confirm incorporation status of the parcel against the City boundary.

items.title: All-in parcel tax rate (tax rate area) unknown
items.detail: Voter-approved debt varies by tax rate area; only the tax bill can confirm it (M88). Prop 13 base 1% is verified (M86).
items.owner_action: Read the current tax bill's rate area.

items.title: Owner's capital-gains tax rates unknown
items.detail: Entity type, filing status and basis are private (M95). The FTB 12.3% + 1% top rates are verified as law (M92-M93) but the applicable rate is not assumed.
items.owner_action: Have a CPA compute the after-tax exit off-site.

items.detail: Address, APN, fault offset, flood/wildfire zone and premium quotes are personal/parcel information. Per the brief they are for internal use only and must not appear on the website (M115). Rows are blank by design.

items.title: 'Elevated closures into 2028' is earnings-call commentary, not a filing
items.detail: The claim appears in third-party transcripts of the Q3 FY2026 call (2026-08-12), not in the 8-K exhibit itself. The verified filing-based facts (4 openings / 17 closures; ~50-60 closures FY guidance) are separated from it in the tenant table; the 2028 comment is marked as call commentary wherever used.

items.title: §1031 does not defer Measure ULA or the documentary transfer tax
items.detail: Section 1031 defers income tax (S16); Measure ULA is an excise tax on the conveyance itself (S10). Some popular commentary conflates them. This workbook models them separately; flagged so the owner's counsel can confirm.
items.owner_action: Confirm with tax counsel before executing.

items.title: BEA county personal income will be superseded 2026-12-02
items.detail: The BEA release itself states the 2024 county data will be superseded by the 2025 release on December 2, 2026 (S19). The $818.5B figure is correct as of access date 2026-11-10 but has a known short shelf life.

items.title: Two official population counts differ by methodology
items.detail: Census V2025 shows county population 9,694,934 (2025-07-01) while CA DOF shows 9,837,286 (2026-01-01). Both are published with their source and date (M02 vs M05); they are not reconciled into one number because the definitions and dates differ.
items.owner_action: Pick one series for a single narrative and state the basis.

items.title: Proposition 3 results are unofficial until 2026-12-11
items.detail: The 60.4% Yes figure is an unofficial SoS print as of 2026-11-09 (M94, S28). Certification is due 2026-12-11. The row is labelled unofficial, not verified.
